description_en: Queries the total pay-as-you-go traffic for all border firewalls
description_zh: 查询后付费计费流量总计，包括各个边界防火墙
name: DescribePostpayTrafficTotal

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

TotalAssets.description_en: The total number of assets that are protected by border firewalls

TotalBillTraffic.description_en: For the subscription edition, this is the total billed elastic traffic after deductions are applied. Unit: bytes
TotalBillTraffic.description_zh: 包年包月版本对应为弹性处理总出账流量，即减免后的流量大小。单位：Byte

TotalInternetAssets.description_en: The total number of assets that are protected by Internet Border firewalls

TotalInternetTraffic.description_en: The total traffic of the Internet Border. For the subscription edition, this is the total elastic traffic of the Internet Border. Unit: bytes
TotalInternetTraffic.description_zh: 互联网边界总流量。包年包月版本对应为互联网边界弹性处理总流量。单位：Byte

TotalNatAssets.description_en: The total number of assets that are protected by NAT border firewalls

TotalNatTraffic.description_en: The total traffic of the NAT border. For the subscription edition, this is the total elastic traffic of the NAT border. Unit: bytes
TotalNatTraffic.description_zh: NAT边界总流量。包年包月版本对应为NAT边界弹性处理总流量。单位：Byte

TotalSdlBillTraffic.description_en: The total billed traffic for data leakage detection
TotalSdlBillTraffic.description_zh: 数据泄漏检测总计费流量

TotalSdlFreeTraffic.description_en: The total free traffic for data leakage detection
TotalSdlFreeTraffic.description_zh: 数据泄漏检测总免费使用流量

TotalTraffic.description_en: The total traffic. For the subscription edition, this is the total elastic traffic. Unit: bytes
TotalTraffic.description_zh: 总流量。包年包月版本对应为弹性处理总流量。单位：Byte

TotalVpcAssets.description_en: The total number of assets that are protected by VPC border firewalls

TotalVpcTraffic.description_en: The total traffic of the VPC border. For the subscription edition, this is the total elastic traffic of the VPC border. Unit: bytes
TotalVpcTraffic.description_zh: VPC边界总流量。包年包月版本对应为VPC边界弹性处理总流量。单位：Byte
